objective: Make evaluation evidence intake strict: reject duplicate JSON object keys, duplicate run IDs with conflicting metadata, unusable or negative task durations and inconsistent run logs before they can reach the release gates.
acceptance: manifest, JSONL event, audit, summary, metrics and comparison inputs reject duplicate object keys at every nesting level
duplicate-key errors identify the input file and JSONL line and duplicate field name without echoing the untrusted body
duplicate run IDs across files fail closed and name both conflicting paths plus any conflicting evaluation metadata
each run log is validated for run_id consistency, contiguous sequence_no, event IDs and known event types before aggregation
nested <output_dir>/<version>/*.jsonl and flat single-version layouts are both ingested with no silent omission
occurred_at is parsed as an explicit timezone-aware RFC 3339 value, reporting file, line and event ID on failure
runner-measured monotonic elapsed time is preferred over cross-node wall-clock subtraction, and each duration records its clock
negative and non-finite durations fail closed and can never be reported as a passing release metric
causal replay order remains sequence_no even when wall clocks move backwards
version, runner, commit and scenario metadata survive ingestion
evidence: focused evaluation tool test output covering duplicate keys, duplicate run IDs, inconsistent logs and invalid durations
release gate output showing a negative duration cannot pass
Task Packet, contract, scenario, golden and context gate output
stop_conditions: a distributed clock synchronization service is required
an interfaces schema, Pydantic contract, World Model ordering or runner semantics change is required
a new JSON or serialization dependency is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
